title: Stripes: Bill Murray's Army Comedy Classic
imageHint: Military boot camp scene with comedic chaos, drill sergeant, and recruits in formation
description: Join John Winger and Russell Ziskey in their hilariously disastrous military adventure. From basic training mishaps to European escapades.

questions.question: Who plays John Winger, the laid-back slacker who joins the Army?
questions.explanation: Bill Murray stars as John Winger, the quintessential slacker who impulsively enlists in the Army after losing his job and girlfriend.

questions.question: What is the name of John's best friend who reluctantly joins the Army with him?
questions.explanation: Russell Ziskey, played by Harold Ramis, is John's neurotic best friend who gets talked into enlisting alongside him.

questions.question: What is the name of their tough drill sergeant?
questions.explanation: Sergeant Hulka, played by Warren Oates, is the no-nonsense drill instructor trying to whip the misfits into shape.

questions.question: What military vehicle do they accidentally commandeer in Europe?
questions.explanation: The squad steals what they think is a military vehicle but turns out to be a recreational vehicle, leading to their European adventure.

questions.question: What year was Stripes released?
questions.explanation: Stripes was released in 1981, becoming one of Bill Murray's breakout film roles and a comedy classic.
